sources.title: Feiertage in Deutschland im Jahr 2027
sources.supports: 2027 nationwide holidays and the extra holidays for each Land (PDF read directly)

culture-cycles.note: State holidays only; the nine nationwide holidays (in 2027: 1 Jan, 26 and 29 Mar, 1 May, 6 and 17 May, 3 Oct, 25 and 26 Dec) are on Germany's record. Several 2027 dates fall on a weekend, and there is no substitute weekday.

laws.rule: Since 1 January 2025 Berlin's overnight stay tax (Übernachtungsteuer, City Tax) is 7.5% of the room price excluding VAT and extras such as breakfast; business stays are also taxed.
